Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jeff Hornacek?

Jeff Hornacek is 63 years old.

Where was Jeff Hornacek born?

Jeff Hornacek was born in Elmhurst, Illinois.

When was Jeff Hornacek born?

Jeff Hornacek was born on May 3, 1963.

How tall is Jeff Hornacek?

Jeff Hornacek is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much did Jeff Hornacek weigh when playing?

Jeff Hornacek weighed 190 lbs (86 kg) when playing.

Is Jeff Hornacek in the Hall of Fame?

Jeff Hornacek is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jeff Hornacek drafted?

Jeff Hornacek was drafted by Phoenix Suns, 2nd round (22nd pick, 46th overall), 1986 NBA Draft.

What position did Jeff Hornacek play?

Shooting Guard and Point Guard.

When did Jeff Hornacek retire?

Jeff Hornacek last played in 2000.

What is Jeff Hornacek's net worth?

Jeff Hornacek made at least $25,962,400 playing professional basketball.

How much did Jeff Hornacek make?

Jeff Hornacek made $5,200,000 in 2000.

What did Jeff Hornacek average?

Jeff Hornacek averaged 14.5 points, 3.4 rebounds, and 4.9 assists per game.

How many rings does Jeff Hornacek have?

Jeff Hornacek won 0 championships.

What schools did Jeff Hornacek attend?

Jeff Hornacek attended Lyons Township in LaGrange, Illinois and Iowa State.

What are Jeff Hornacek's nicknames?

Horny, Scarecrow, The Paperboy are nicknames for Jeff Hornacek.
